discovery_benchmark.description: TM reports 536 attestations of texts with Phrygian language/script and says it should contain most Phrygian inscriptions based on Brixhe & Lejeune 1984 plus journal additions.

current_reference_layer.comparison_caution: Distinct UD-linked TM IDs and TM language-page attestations are useful coverage signals but must be reconciled record-by-record before asserting exact missing-object count.

rights.tm_data_services: TM states public data services are CC BY-SA 4.0; retain attribution/share-alike requirements for imported TM data.
rights.ud: UD Phrygian-KUL is CC BY-SA 4.0; it remains a dependent annotated reference layer.

source_independence: TM identity/metadata and UD linguistic annotation are not automatically independent epigraphic witnesses; both point to published editions.
